requirements.label: required-courses
requirements.title: Required Courses
requirements.sourceText: The following courses (9 credits) are required of mass communication minors; an asterisk (*) denotes an online course: COM 106 - Introduction to Mass Media 3 credits *; COM 120 - Fundamentals of Public Speaking 3 credits *; COM 305 - Mass Communication Law & Ethics 3 credits *

requirements.label: electives
requirements.title: Electives
requirements.sourceText: Three electives (9 credits) at or above the 300 level are required; an asterisk (*) denotes an online course. Students may choose from the following (all three-credit courses): COM 306 - Modes of Media Criticism 3 credits; COM 307 - Critical Media Theory 3 credits; COM 316 - Mass Communication Research Methods 3 credits; COM 317 - Mass Communication Theory 3 credits; JRN 301 - The Changing News Business 3 credits; JRN 319 - The Image of the Journalist in Popular Culture 3 credits; JRN 363 - Magazine Writing 3 credits; COM 365 - Talking Science 3 credits; JRN 366 - Press & the Presidency 3 credits; COM 399 - Special Topics in Mass Communication 3 credits; JRN 413 - Journalisms of the Global South 3 credits; COM 436 - Environmental Communication 3 credits

notes.text: Advising: Visit SoCJ Undergraduate Advising for program resources and ways to connect with an advisor. Director of Undergraduate Studies: Irene Virag, Melville Library N-4004, socjadvising@stonybrook.edu.
Transfer courses will be evaluated individually for mass communication equivalency by the Undergraduate Director.
An asterisk (*) denotes an online course.
